Schemes received by this app are automatically recorded in full and kept on this device. Window switches cannot reveal other apps’ URIs or prove who launched them. Tap for details.

Schemes received by this app are automatically saved as complete URIs, including paths and parameters that may be sensitive. Caller hints are supplied by the sender and may be inaccurate. Accessibility observes app window switches only after being enabled in system settings; it cannot read other apps’ schemes or Intents, or establish who launched an app. Events may be missed or misidentified. Records stay on this device and can be searched, copied or deleted.
Window switch · Not a caller relationship
Schemes Interceptor App window switch recording

When enabled, Schemes Interceptor observes app window events in the background. It stores only the time, previous and next package names, and target window class on this device to help investigate app transitions. It does not read screen text or perform actions. It cannot obtain other apps’ original URIs, and a window switch does not prove that the previous app launched the next one. Disable it at any time in system accessibility settings; clear history from Jump records. If the service is missing from Accessibility settings, tap Open app info and choose Allow restricted settings from the top-right menu, then return and open Accessibility settings again.
